title: Cyrene Teams channel connector activation configuration

bot_app_id.description: Microsoft Entra application ID for the dedicated Cyrene Teams bot.

allowed_team_ids.description: Explicit Team IDs allowed by this binding; add a new Team here only after RSC consent and Directory policy are configured.

personal_chat_enabled.description: Opt-in support for authenticated one-person bot conversations. Keep false until the host has an approved active personal-install binding; this does not grant a user role or add Graph permissions.

client_secret_env_ref.description: Host secret reference resolved only inside the Plugin runtime; the secret value must never be stored in this configuration.

service_url.description: Optional compatibility base URL. Production sends use the verified per-activity service URL carried in signed route metadata.
